d: Under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, Maharashtra’s new Class 6 textbooks bring ancient Indian scholars into science and geography, placing Bhaskaracharya II alongside Isaac Newton and drawing on the Vedas and Puranas. The books also introduce five women scholars from the Vedic period. But while the books expand coverage of traditional knowledge, they reduce the explanation of how the varna system evolved into caste to a single line, reigniting debate over curriculum changes.
